denominator: Original actually ACK-placed orders; complete original terminal+later complete fill tape+durable closed required for zero/partial/full. Open, unknown, no-network and never-sent are separate statuses.
groupings: covered opposite BUY or coverage unknown
reviewed fundamental BUY by original execution mode
features: Only original scope/order/book/known-own-liquidity evidence available strictly before original POST ACK.requestStartedAt; no response, fill, terminal or future-book feature.
bookVersion: Original (sequence,asOf.at), exact pair conflicts/rollback refused; original source/receipt/processing/earliest availability remain distinct.
label: First original same-scope full book whose source is in [actual execution+h,execution+h+5s]; invalid/stale/late/shallow first candidate remains missing, never replaced favorably. Full actual fill quantity at genuine depth; YES/NO complement; recorded entry fees exact, future exit fee unknown unless independently witnessed.
unavailable: Report absent, late, stale, invalid, shallow, gap, clock conflict and right censoring separately; no missing/censored-to-zero.

fitConditions.split: First two thirds of original ACK time blocks for training, final third for test; training terminal and mark labels must have been available before first test ACK start; no tuning or fitted threshold search.

fitMeaning: At most a simple same-stratum zero/partial/full Dirichlet baseline and filled-fraction/conditional markout diagnostic; cancellation and closure selection informative, no independent censoring or live calibration assumed.
limitations: Historical markouts are displayed-depth execution-quality labels, not actual hypothetical fills or realizable portfolio profit.
Immediate-vs-rested-after-ACK is not venue maker/taker classification.
Short-horizon fundamental marks do not value terminal settlement holdings.
Time blocks/markets may remain correlated; no IID fills/pairs confidence claim.
No inferred party mapping, unknown fee, source clock renewal, new API/client, or financial authority.
